findings.element: Running view attention list - 'third-shop (Shopify) creates Non-inventory items · Open Settings'
findings.finding: The attention-list Open Settings link gives no instructions (none of step 2's numbered path) and no Check again, so the only way to clear the item is hidden behind 'Review steps' under a summary that says setup is complete.
findings.user_impact: A user adding a store after setup is sent to general Settings without knowing which tab or field to change, and on return cannot confirm the fix, so the Non-inventory store never gets a working setting and sync stays broken for it.
findings.suggested_fix: When an attention item needs the step-2 fix, show the same numbered path and a Check again button inline (or make the link open step 2 directly).

evidence.action: In running view, connect third-shop via '+ Connect another Shopify store', choose a location, then click 'Open Settings' on the attention line
evidence.observed: Toast 'Settings opened in a new tab.' appears and the attention line stays as is; state map records 'no Check again offered in running view'. Check again and the numbered path only appear after clicking 'Review steps', where step 2 re-opens.

findings.element: Running view setup summary row 'Setup · 5 of 5 done'
findings.finding: The setup summary always reads '5 of 5 done', even when a newly added store has re-opened step 2 and the expanded view shows 'Step 2 of 5 · 4 done'.
findings.user_impact: The UI implies the job is finished while a required step for the new store is open, the KF-2 pattern, so users skip the unfinished work.
findings.suggested_fix: Compute the summary from actual step state (e.g. 'Setup · 4 of 5 done · 1 step needs attention') and open the unfinished step when Review steps is clicked.

evidence.action: In running view with third-shop connected (Non-inventory setting), read the setup summary row, then click 'Review steps'
evidence.observed: Collapsed row reads 'Setup · 5 of 5 done'; expanded card reads 'Step 2 of 5 · 4 done' with step 2 open and third-shop needing change.

findings.element: Compare stock tab - row 'Ignore' action vs 'Compare now'
findings.finding: Ignoring a mismatch lasts only until the next 'Compare now', which silently resets the row to Unresolved with the action buttons back.
findings.user_impact: Users who deliberately dismiss a known difference see it come back every time they compare, so they can't use the tab to reach a clean list and may think their choice was lost or ignored.
findings.suggested_fix: Persist the Ignored resolution across comparisons until quantities change or the user un-ignores it.

evidence.action: In Compare stock tab (running demo), click Ignore on Stone 13 (-122), then click Compare now
evidence.observed: After Ignore, Stone 13 shows 'Ignored' with no actions; after Compare now it shows 'Unresolved' again with 'Set Shopify to QuickBooks' and 'Ignore'.

findings.element: Compare stock tab row action 'Set Shopify to QuickBooks' vs step 4 bulk 'Set Shopify to QuickBooks numbers'
findings.finding: The same stock-overwriting action asks for confirmation in step 4 but runs instantly with no confirmation in the Compare stock tab.
findings.user_impact: A user who learned in setup that this action is confirmed can overwrite live Shopify stock with one click in Compare stock, including on rows where QuickBooks has negative quantities.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the step-4 confirm modal (or an undo toast) for the per-row action in Compare stock too.

evidence.action: Click 'Set Shopify to QuickBooks numbers (8)' in step 4, then in Compare stock tab click 'Set Shopify to QuickBooks' on Stone 12
evidence.observed: Step 4 opens modal 'Set Shopify stock to QuickBooks?' with Cancel; in Compare stock, Stone 12 immediately becomes Shopify 137 / 'Set to QuickBooks' with no confirmation.

gaps: Check again when the setting is still unchanged: branch not built (always succeeds), so it is unknown whether the user gets a recovery message or loops
Open Settings / View in Shopify only toast or have no target, so the round-trip return from Synder Settings (tab focus, whether the page refreshes) cannot be judged
Step 4 Skip was not exercised in the state map, so the warning state it leaves in step 4 and in the running view cannot be verified
Disconnect a store while sync is running (including the last store in V2) not exercised; whether it confirms and what the running view shows with 0 stores is unknown
Held / Failed events never occurred, so their error states and recovery actions are unknown

After the step-4 bulk update (modal says 'Synder creates one sync event per product'), the V1 running view shows Pending 0 / Applied (24h) 0; the Events tab contents in that state were not recorded, so whether users can confirm the update happened is unclear
